result:
F-DG5-146 is fixed in the source, but its e2e regression on the real stack could not run in this session. This sandbox can't start PostgreSQL, so the four required e2e specs (acceptance item 3) were not run. Every other required check passed. The changes are left uncommitted, and the handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-FE-Z1B-frontend-ux-engineer.md`.

**Why the e2e is blocked:** the test harness starts PostgreSQL through `unshare --user` when it runs as root. In this sandbox `max_user_namespaces` is 0 and only root is mapped, so neither that nor switching to uid 1000 works. It's the same condition D-176 describes, and I didn't try to get around it. The before run and the runs of all four specs in both locale settings each stopped with exit 1 before any test started; the logs are in the evidence folder.

**The fix:**
- **Tables wrapped:** the Form builder's field table and the form framework's Attachments table, plus its History table (same file, same defect), are now in `TableScrollRegion`. It is keyboard-focusable and named in en and ar.
- **One file beyond my ownership:** `ExportDialog.tsx` was the third use of the unstyled `div.table-scroll`. D-176 says to remove that class and the guard refuses it, so this 3-line change was unavoidable. Please confirm it.
- **Nothing else changed:** no CSS, no translation keys, no contract or schema change, no dependency.

**Unit guard (`table-regions.test.tsx`):**
- It now refuses the class `table-scroll` and any `table.table` / `table--compact` that isn't inside a scroll region. It parses the source with the TypeScript compiler the build already uses, so no new dependency.
- Before the fix: exit 1, naming exactly the defective tables. After: 9 of 9 pass.
- It doesn't fully meet D-176's "any table": it lists four pre-P5 tables outside my ownership as an exact exception list, so a new bare table or a fixed one both fail it. Two of them (the 409 conflict tables) already don't widen the page (D-174). The other two, `UsersPage > UserEdit` and `DefinePage > GoodOutcomeTest`, have no reflow measurement and need an owner. Wrapping each is a two-line change.

**What I could show without a database:** I laid out the product's own component renders in real Chromium with the built stylesheet.
- **Before the fix:** the page scrolls sideways in 16 of 44 cases, up to 562 px. These match qa's figures exactly.
- **After the fix:** no case scrolls, max 0 px.
- **Keyboard:** Tab reaches each table's region with a visible focus outline. The arrow keys scroll the table inside it while the page stays put, in en and ar.
- **Screenshots:** before/after at 390 px in both languages, in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-FE-Z1B-evidence/shots/`. These come from rendered markup, not the running stack.

**The FE-Z1 work-in-progress spec:** I kept it with two corrections.
- **Auditor check:** while a draft is open, the Form builder opens that draft by default. The spec's "auditor read-only view" was therefore measuring the draft; the auditor now picks the published version explicitly.
- **Export preview:** its "must scroll" set-up check contradicted the spec's own comment, so it's now optional there.

**Checks:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, Prettier check, `pnpm openapi:lint` | all exit 0 |
| `unit-web`, locale unset | 1,713 passed (90 files), exit 0 |
| `unit-web`, C.UTF-8 | 1,713 passed (90 files), exit 0 |
| DG4 historical validation, start and end | PASS, exit 0 |
| The four e2e specs, en and ar, both locale settings | not run (blocked, see above) |

`pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration` and the full e2e suite were not run, per D-164.

**Still to do:** run the four e2e specs where the harness can start PostgreSQL. The failing-before e2e output now needs a run against the pre-fix commit `d63afd4`.

There is no contract, schema or dependency need. No ADR, data-dictionary statement or user-facing text was made untrue. The run took 19:22–19:54Z.
